contract: Model of first K=64 panel in the first 32 logical workgroup IDs. Physical execution ordering, cache geometry, cache misses, DRAM traffic and timing are NOT modeled or measured. 128-byte buckets and 4-KiB regions are illustrative address units, not asserted hardware cache/page sizes. No cross-panel reuse or compiler register effects. Exhaustive tile permutation validation is separate from performance.
